name: Gold Records
description: ROXIE came to JOHTO looking for a music scene and found temple bells and a sleeping WOOPER, so she starts a band out of spite and makes you its manager. Recruit FEEDBACK and CASEY, showcase a Pokemon, busk for the Olivine crowd, earn the Underground's respect, wake that WOOPER, and defend the NATIONAL PARK encore when PIERS arrives. ALPHA: the quest currently ends after the PIERS battle. POKEMON GOLD ONLY; this mod does not load on Red, Blue or Yellow.
